senses.gloss: f. (קְשֵׁי) stone of date or olive.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 49a:4">Ḥull. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>האי ק׳ דאשתכחא וכ׳</he> (not <he>דאשתכח</he>) a date stone was found in the gall &c.—Pl. <cite ref="S02240"><he>קַשְׁיָאתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="S02248"><he>קַשְׁיָיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:1">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> thou shalt see in thy dream that the Romans capture thee <he>וטחני בך ק׳ וכ׳</he> (different in Ms. M.) and make thee grind date stones in a golden mill.
<cite ref="Yoma 79b:1">Yoma 79ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>תרי … דק׳ וכ׳</he> in two kabs of dates there is one kab of stones and more.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:9">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ דזיתי</he> olive stones.—V. <cite ref="S02238"><he>קָשֵׁי</he></cite>.
